candidate_evidence.quote: Ultrasound combined with microbubbles to facilitate sampling of biomarkers from brain tumors via blood-based liquid biopsy

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Must be newly diagnosed with a lesion in the brain with imaging characteristics consistent with glioblastoma multiforme.
Patients with recurrent GBM who are planning to undergo surgical resection or laser ablation of the recurrent tumor.

role_evidence.quote: a standard ultrasound contrast agent (microbubbles) is injected intravenously

biomarkers.biomarker_other: circulating tumour DNA tumour-specific variants (liquid biopsy)

source_quote.quote: Number of matched mutations between the post-sonobiopsy sample and the tumor tissue sample

coder_notes: Diagnostic sonobiopsy (focused ultrasound with microbubbles) for liquid biopsy; no therapeutic agent. Definity is registered as a Device but is an ultrasound contrast agent, listed as diagnostic_agent. ctDNA is the diagnostic endpoint rather than a biomarker for a therapy.
